llm_response.reason: The site mimics the famous Happy Socks brand, but the domain is freshly registered with privacy-shielded WHOIS and warnings about bogus contact details. There is no display of a verifiable French company, no SIRET registration, or business address. The About page is vague and avoids official company info. No verifiable links to the real Happy Socks. SSL certificate errors add security risks. The legitimate Happy Socks company uses different domains and has proper authentication. All these signs strongly align with characteristics of a scam/fake online shopping website, especially brand spoofing and recent domain creation.
